page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: only a narrow strip of its outer margin, with dense small marginal text that is too damaged to read. Right page: one column of main text with Greek and Latin entries, running head "TP" and page number 457 at the top, no catchword.

main_text.p: herba à semine tribuli, cujus formam externam triquetram esse perhibent, Matth. 7. v.16.
Τελεσία ὡς ἡ Actor.20.31. triennium, à nomine τριετής ἐ ὁ ἡ trimus a, triennis, qui est trium annorum, 2.Chron.31.16. ex τρία & ἕτα ἡ τὰ, anni. à sing. ἔτος ἐ τὸ annus.
Τείζω strideo καὶ ὀνομαστικῶς, h.e. ex sone factum. F.τρίζω.prat.med.τέτριχα.
Τειμῆνον ἐ τὸ trimestre spatium, anni quadrans, q.d. τρεῖς μῆνες tres menses. μὴν μηνὸς ὁ mensis.
Τεῖς ter Adv. Actor.10.16. ἐπὶ τρεῖς jum drit ten mal.
Τείσεγον ἐ τὸ, q.d. ἡ τρίτη στέγη, tertia contignatio. στέγη ἡς ἡ proprie tectum, à στέγω tego.

Τείτ@ ἡ ον tertius a um. Them. τρεῖς tres. τὸ τρίτον scilicet μέρος tertia pars. τρίτον Adv. tertiò Marc.14. v.41. ἐκ τρίτης tertia vice Matth.26.44. 2.Cor.12.2. τρίτος οὐρανός tertium coelum, locus beatorum, per metaph. vocatur etiam paradisus Luc.23. verf.43. 2.Cor.12.4.
Τείχιν@ ἴνη ἴνον cilicinus a um. confectus ex pilis seu crinibus. Them. τρίχ ἡ crinis, pilus, Apoc.6.12.
Τροπή ἡς ἡ converfio. Th. τρέπω.
Τρόπ@ ὁ modus, mores. Th. τρόπος.

page.notes: The left page strip carries dense marginal notes that I cannot read reliably; they are not transcribed. A mark "V" stands alone at the bottom right of the right page, below the last line; it is not a catchword or signature in the text block, so it is left out. Greek forms are approximate where marked by the printed small type and damaged letters; the headword spellings should be checked against the scan.
